description: A self-healing script for WiFi interfaces and related components, managing WiFi radio states, memory usage, interface status, and device reboot logic.

methods.name: onewifi_restart_wifi
methods.description: Restarts the onewifi service and logs the action.

methods.name: vap_restart
methods.description: Restores WiFi access point support and logs the action.

methods.name: print_wifi_2g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current 2G WiFi probe request and response counts.

methods.name: sync_all_wifi_2g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Synchronizes the 2G WiFi probe counts from hardware counters.

methods.name: check_wifi_2g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if 2G WiFi is stuck and reinitializes if necessary.

methods.name: print_wifi_5g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Logs the current 5G WiFi probe request and response counts.

methods.name: sync_all_wifi_5g_txprobe_cnt
methods.description: Synchronizes the 5G WiFi probe counts from hardware counters.

methods.name: check_wifi_5g_stuck_status
methods.description: Checks if 5G WiFi is stuck and reinitializes if necessary.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_full
methods.description: Checks if BSS queue is full and sets a flag.

methods.name: wave_driver_restart
methods.description: Restarts wave driver and WiFi services for CMXB7 devices.

methods.name: check_bss_queue_one_min
methods.description: Checks BSS queue status over one minute interval.

methods.name: onewifi_conn_clients_count
methods.description: Counts total connected WiFi clients across radios.

methods.name: check_lnf_status
methods.description: Checks and restores LNF interfaces if disabled.

methods.name: onewifi_mem_restart
methods.description: Restarts OneWifi process if memory usage exceeds thresholds.
